name: The Backyard
title: Window Cleaning in The Backyard, Bee Cave TX | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for condos and townhomes in The Backyard district of Bee Cave. Pure water, water fed poles, $10 per window, $200 minimum job.
intro: The Backyard is a walkable district in Bee Cave built around the Live Oak Amphitheater, with condos and townhomes still being added. CleanzATX cleans residential windows here using pure water and clear scheduling.

sections.h2: What The Backyard homes are like
paragraphs: The Backyard is a mixed use district, with residences going up alongside shops and event space. At its center is the Live Oak Amphitheater, and the idea is that people can walk from home to dinner to a show. The housing is condos and townhomes, and since the project is still growing, sizes and prices vary by building. There is no gate and no HOA listed for the area, and each building may have its own association rules. Units are often tall, with big glass to take in the view of the lawn and the trees.
Because buildings are new or still arriving, windows are modern, large and often floor to ceiling.

sections.h2: What The Backyard windows deal with
paragraphs: New glass in a busy district collects dust from construction, foot traffic and event crowds. Fingerprints and dust gather on balcony doors, and bird droppings are common near open lawns and trees. Live oak pollen in spring and cedar pollen in winter settle on every flat surface. Sprinklers watering common areas can spray the lower windows and leave white spots in a pattern that is easy to see. West facing floor to ceiling glass shows streaks in the evening sun, just when residents sit down to watch it.
Newer windows are often coated, so we use soft tools and pure water rather than harsh chemicals.

Each building has its own access, so tell us about parking, entry codes and any association rules when you text. We keep hoses and equipment off shared walkways and work quietly. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so most lower and mid level exterior glass is covered from the ground without ladders. For upper floors we look at the building first and tell you what can and cannot be reached. Indoors at The Backyard, panes are hand squeegeed over drop cloths. Since multiple owners often live in the same building, neighbors can book together.

Prices depend on the unit. As a general guide, a 2,000 square foot unit is about $200 for exterior windows, which is our minimum job. Plan on 90 minutes to two hours outside, plus about an hour inside.

faq.q: Can you clean upper floor windows in a condo building?
faq.a: We can reach up to three stories from the ground with water fed poles. Taller or hard to access glass depends on the building, so tell us the floor and we confirm what is possible.

faq.q: Do I need permission from the building?
faq.a: Possibly. Some buildings have rules for contractors. Ask your association, and tell us any requirements for parking, hours or entry so we follow them.
Exterior windows are $10 each or about $0.10 per square foot. Cleaning inside and out in The Backyard is $15 per window. The minimum job is $200, so a smaller unit may be brought up to that.

faq.q: Do you clean balcony glass and doors?
faq.a: Yes, glass on balconies and sliding doors counts as windows. Railings and floors are separate, so ask when you text and we will say what we can do.

faq.q: Why are my windows spotty near the lawn?
faq.a: Sprinkler spray with hard water leaves white mineral spots on lower glass. Hard water spot removal is $10 per pane, and plans can include it on up to 5 windows each visit.
Text (512) 518-0512 with the building name and your floor. Tyler quotes, usually within the hour during business hours, and scheduling is typically within two weeks.
